class_id_semantics.hardware_class: The class ID identifies a registered hardware family and, when present, an effective physical-core slice width plus an explicit SMT-on lane suffix. It does not silently encode a thread-pool size, NUMA policy, or Apple P/E execution mode.
class_id_semantics.threadripper_smt_semantics: No suffix means one hardware thread per effective physical core. The -smt2 suffix is mandatory when two sibling hardware threads per core are admitted.
class_id_semantics.execution_identity: The class ID binds Threadripper physical width and SMT lane; the receipt independently proves SMT state. Logical CPU set, thread budget, NUMA policy, Apple execution mode, thermal state, durability treatment, and the A/A tolerance key remain separately bound execution identity.
class_id_semantics.cross_class_policy: Ratios, null bands, and promotion baselines never cross a canonical class ID or execution-identity key.

canonical_hash_contract.canonical_json_subset: UTF-8 compact JSON with object keys sorted lexicographically, arrays in source order, integers in base-10 without leading zeros, and only ASCII strings, booleans, null, arrays, and objects. The bytes are exactly jq -cS output with its trailing newline removed.
canonical_hash_contract.registry_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact registry file bytes without rewriting whitespace.
canonical_hash_contract.hardware_fingerprint_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the hardware object with fingerprint_sha256 omitted.
canonical_hash_contract.effective_cpuset_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing observed_logical_cpu_ids, effective_physical_core_ids, cpu_assignment_observability, threads_per_core, and smt_state from one execution snapshot.
canonical_hash_contract.execution_snapshot_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for one complete execution snapshot with snapshot_sha256 omitted.
canonical_hash_contract.execution_identity_sha256: After start/end equivalence is proven, SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing requested_class_id, derived_class_id, execution.request, and the stable execution fields from execution.start except thermal_pressure and snapshot_sha256.
canonical_hash_contract.command_sha256: SHA-256 over the exact argv byte strings separated and terminated by NUL; shell-joined command text is never hashed as a substitute.
derived_field_order: execution.start/end.snapshot_sha256 from each complete materialized snapshot
fixture_materialization_order: apply set, remove, and add_unknown mutations
derive every field containing a $DERIVE_* placeholder in dependency order
do not overwrite any derived field explicitly targeted by the vector set mutation

validation_precedence: registry syntax, duplicate keys, schema version, and unknown fields
registry self-consistency, class-rule collision, and source fingerprint provenance
receipt syntax, duplicate keys, schema version, required fields, and unknown fields

classes.notes: The label remains diagnostic-only until bd-9f03f proves worker homogeneity or splits materially different workers into distinct classes.

execution_predicates.apple_execution_mode_semantics: requested pool and scheduler policy; never a hard-affinity claim unless requested and observed CPU sets prove it

classes.notes: No M5 fingerprint may be invented. Registration requires a reachable named host, committed raw fingerprint, and an explicit registry revision.

requirements.text: Consumers load this exact versioned registry and reject duplicate keys plus unknown registry or receipt fields.
Class resolution is deterministic and rejects unknown, obsolete, or multiply matching IDs.
Hardware identity plus explicit execution request, start snapshot, and end snapshot are separately recorded and jointly admitted.
Threadripper admission matches the registered 5995WX vendor, family, model, stepping, topology, page size, and NUMA facts.
The trj class width equals the unique effective physical-core count; logical CPUs equal physical cores times the recorded threads per core.
The Threadripper SMT suffix and recorded SMT state agree; requested and observed CPU sets, assignment observability, thread budget, NUMA policy, and governor remain explicit execution identity.
M4 admission matches Apple M4 Pro, 10P+4E, 14 logical CPUs, 64 GiB, and 16384-byte pages.
Apple P-only and P-plus-E requests are distinct execution identities and thermal warnings reject timed evidence.
Provisional and unavailable classes are diagnostic-only and cannot promote history.
Timed evidence requires a clean exact source, local execution, and an exclusive measurement lease.
Source, Cargo.lock, executable, NUL-delimited command argv, topology, hardware, cpuset, snapshots, and execution identity are hash-bound under one canonical byte contract.
Durability-adjacent evidence binds identical control and candidate sync treatment.
Only a zero-exit sealed completion with verified log and artifact digests can support promotion.
Start and end snapshots carry recomputable hardware and execution facts; identity drift is fail-closed.
A requested or CLI machine class is compared with, and cannot relabel, the class derived from verified receipt facts.
Baselines, candidates, reruns, A/A bands, and destination stems match canonical class plus execution identity.
Every rejection returns one stable reason code and writes no promotion history.
Every registered class cites immutable raw fingerprint provenance; missing hardware is never fabricated.
Receipts retain hostname, kernel, microcode, cache topology, and load for diagnosis even when those fields are not class predicates.
Consumers emit bounded structured logs naming requirement ID, class, field, observed value, expected predicate, and reason code.

test_vector_mutation_format.raw_json: When non-null, parse these exact bytes instead of a named template; this is used for syntax-level cases such as duplicate receipt keys.

placeholders.$REGISTRY_SHA256: Substitute the lowercase SHA-256 of the exact registry bytes.
placeholders.$DERIVE_HARDWARE_FINGERPRINT_SHA256: Derive from the materialized hardware object according to canonical_hash_contract.
placeholders.$DERIVE_START_CPUSET_SHA256: Derive from the materialized execution.start CPU-assignment fields.
placeholders.$DERIVE_END_CPUSET_SHA256: Derive from the materialized execution.end CPU-assignment fields.
placeholders.$DERIVE_START_SNAPSHOT_SHA256: Derive from the materialized execution.start object.
placeholders.$DERIVE_END_SNAPSHOT_SHA256: Derive from the materialized execution.end object.
placeholders.$DERIVE_EXECUTION_IDENTITY_SHA256: Derive only after start/end equivalence passes.

test_vector_mutation_format.set: A map from dotted field path to replacement JSON value.
test_vector_mutation_format.remove: A list of dotted field paths removed before validation.
test_vector_mutation_format.add_unknown: A map from dotted field path to a field that strict consumers must reject.
test_vector_mutation_format.admission_context: Optional external ratchet context applied only after receipt validation. destination_basename must equal QG-<n>.<derived_class_id>.latest.json exactly and cannot relabel the receipt.

test_vector_expected_contract.decision: The terminal admission state: allow, diagnostic_only, reject, or reject_registry.
test_vector_expected_contract.class_id: The canonical derived class on allow/diagnostic_only, otherwise null.
test_vector_expected_contract.reason: Exactly one stable member of reason_codes.
test_vector_expected_contract.derived_sha256: Required for every fully materialized allow vector. Consumers recompute all five values independently and compare these golden digests before treating the shared corpus as self-hosting.

registry_test_vector_mutation_format.raw_json: When non-null, parse these exact bytes instead of mutating the canonical registry; this is used for syntax-level cases such as duplicate keys.
registry_test_vector_mutation_format.add_class: Append one complete class rule to classes before loading the registry.
registry_test_vector_mutation_format.set: A map from dotted registry field path to replacement JSON value.
registry_test_vector_mutation_format.remove: A list of dotted registry field paths removed before loading.
registry_test_vector_mutation_format.add_unknown: A map from dotted registry field path to a field that strict consumers must reject.
